Title: General Availability: Azure Advisor recommendation improves the reliability of Azure Disks with Zone Redundant Storage

Body.Content:
Disks with Zone Redundant Storage (ZRS) provide synchronous replication of data across three Availability Zones in a region. By adopting this recommendation, you can now design your solutions to utilize ZRS Disks, ensuring your disks can withstand a zonal outage. With this, you can expect enhanced resiliency in your workload by avoiding downtime and business interruptions. 

To learn more adopting the best practice, visit Reliability recommendations - Azure Advisor | Microsoft Learn.
